name: UI：生图节点-模型类型下拉选项枚举验证
description: 验证生图节点模型类型Select下拉选项完整枚举，记录可用模型列表，验证选择后回显正确

steps.description: 打开含生图节点的策略详情页
验证生图详情页已加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const allEls = document.querySelectorAll('*'); for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t === '生图' && el.children.length === 0) { const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); if (rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } for (const el of allEls) { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); if (t.includes('生图') && el.children.length <= 2 && el.closest('[class*=node], [class*=Node], [class*=card], [class*=Card]')) { el.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const modelItem = formItems.find(i => { const label = (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || ''); return label.includes('模型类型'); }); if (!modelItem) return { open: true, noModelField: true }; const select = modelItem.querySelector('.ant-select'); if (!select) return { open: true, noSelect: true }; const currentValue = (select.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item')?.textContent || '').trim(); const isRequired = !!modelItem.querySelector('.ant-form-item-required') || !!modelItem.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label .anticon-star'); return { open: true, modelCurrentValue: currentValue, isRequired, selectExists: true }; })()
steps.description: 检查模型类型Select初始值和必填标记
模型类型为必填字段(有*标记)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return false; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const modelItem = formItems.find(i => (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').includes('模型类型')); if (!modelItem) return false; const sel = modelItem.querySelector('.ant-select .ant-select-selector'); if (sel) { sel.setAttribute('data-testid', 'model-select'); return true; } return false; })()

steps.description: 点击模型类型Select展开下拉

steps.expression: return (() => { const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); const visibleDropdown = Array.from(dropdowns).find(d => { const rect = d.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width > 100 && rect.height > 30; }); if (!visibleDropdown) { const allDropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown'); return { dropdownFound: false, totalDropdowns: allDropdowns.length, hiddenDropdowns: document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown.ant-select-dropdown-hidden').length }; } const options = Array.from(visibleDropdown.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')); const optionValues = options.map(o => { const text = (o.querySelector('.ant-select-item-option-content')?.textContent || o.textContent || '').trim(); return text; }); return { dropdownFound: true, optionCount: options.length, options: optionValues.slice(0, 20) }; })()
steps.description: 枚举模型类型下拉全部选项
模型类型下拉列表已展开
模型类型至少1个可选模型

steps.expression: return (() => { const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); const visibleDropdown = Array.from(dropdowns).find(d => { const rect = d.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width > 100 && rect.height > 30; }); if (!visibleDropdown) return {}; const options = Array.from(visibleDropdown.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')); if (options.length === 0) return { noOptions: true }; const firstOption = options[0]; firstOption.click(); const selectedText = (firstOption.querySelector('.ant-select-item-option-content')?.textContent || firstOption.textContent || '').trim(); return { selectedFirst: true, selectedText }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const modelItem = formItems.find(i => (i.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').includes('模型类型')); if (!modelItem) return {}; const select = modelItem.querySelector('.ant-select'); const currentValue = (select?.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item')?.textContent || '').trim(); return { afterSelectValue: currentValue, hasValue: currentValue.length > 0 }; })()

steps.description: 选择模型后Select显示对应值

steps.expression: return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { open: false }; const inputs = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('input:not([type=checkbox]), textarea')); const filledInputs = {}; for (const inp of inputs) { const label = (inp.closest('.ant-form-item')?.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); if (label.includes('seller')) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(inp, 'test_seller_001'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); filledInputs.seller_id = 'test_seller_001'; } } return { open: true, filledInputs }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btns = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')); const runBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '运行' || t === '开始运行' || t.includes('运行'); }); if (runBtn && !runBtn.disabled) { runBtn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (modal) { const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-close'); if (closeBtn) closeBtn.click(); } return { closed: true }; })()

steps.description: 等待弹窗关闭和状态更新

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const resultBtn = btns.find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '查看运行结果'; }); if (resultBtn) { resultBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待运行结果页面加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const hasResult = text.includes('运行结果') || text.includes('成功') || text.includes('完成') || text.includes('输出') || text.includes('试运行') || text.includes('策略'); const hasError = text.includes('失败') || text.includes('错误'); const hasLoading = text.includes('运行中') || !!document.querySelector('.ant-spin-spinning'); const urls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"']+(?:\.jpg|\.png|\.webp|\.jpeg)/gi) || []; const allUrls = text.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<]+/gi) || []; return { hasLoading, hasResult, hasError, imageUrlCount: urls.length, allUrlCount: allUrls.length, textPreview: text.substring(0, 200) }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在含生图节点的策略(10602)
